question.text: In an AIF formed as an LLP, the responsibility for statutory compliance under the LLP Act rests primarily with:

answer.text: The Designated Partners (at least two) of the LLP, one of whom is typically the Sponsor

explanation.text: The Logic: Chapter 8.4/8.5: every LLP must have at least two Designated Partners responsible for statutory compliance under the LLP Act. In AIF LLPs, the Sponsor is typically a Designated Partner. The Trap: Option A mis-allocates. Option C confuses with normal partnership. Option D is fabricated — LLPs have no 'Trustee'. Cross-Exam Context: XIX-C tests LLP governance specifics rarely covered in XIX-A/B.
